dental.name: Dental Clinic Management
dental.short: End-to-end dental workflow: appointments, odontogram, treatment plans, and billing.
dental.long: CureOx Dental connects clinical work with admin and finance. From odontogram and treatment plans to attachments, invoicing, and reports—everything stays organized in one place.
highlights: Chair-aware scheduling with reminders and time optimization
Interactive odontogram, treatment plans, and session tracking

pharmacy.name: Pharmacy Management
pharmacy.short: POS + inventory + accounting for modern pharmacies.
pharmacy.long: CureOx Pharmacy manages sales, purchasing, and stock with high accuracy. It supports barcode, batches/expiries, and produces operational and financial reports to speed decisions.
highlights: Fast POS with barcode and returns
Purchasing, suppliers, margins, and accounting reports

medical.name: Medical Clinic Management
medical.short: EMR, scheduling, prescriptions, and billing in one system.
medical.long: CureOx Clinic streamlines appointments, visits, EMR documentation, and prescriptions—with dashboards and reports to measure performance and improve operations.
highlights: Comprehensive patient file and templated visit documentation

patient.name: Patient App
patient.short: Bookings, prescriptions, results, and secure messaging—on the patient’s phone.
patient.long: CureOx Patient makes the patient journey easier: book and manage appointments, view prescriptions and results, receive reminders, and communicate securely with care providers.
highlights: Book and manage appointments with reminders

distributor.name: Warehouse/Distributor System
distributor.short: Inventory operations, order fulfillment, and direct pharmacy integration.
distributor.long: CureOx Warehouse/Distributor organizes receiving, storage, picking/packing, and delivery with invoices and notes—plus direct integration to accept pharmacy orders and update their status.
highlights: Multi-warehouse stock with locations, batches, and expiries
Invoicing, collections, and distribution & stock reporting
